Manage my team on Vimeo OTT

You can add members of your team to your Vimeo OTT site with permissions including managing features, curating content, or reviewing the dashboard.

In this article

  • Roles and permissions
  • Add a new Admin/team member
  • Change a team member’s role

Roles and permissions

There are multiple roles you can grant, each with a different level of access:

  • Admin - Admins have full view/edit access to the Admin Dashboard and to your Vimeo OTT Site. Admins can add new team members and access financial information. Admins have access to Bumpers. Admins have the same level of access as Owners.
  • Member - Members have limited access to the Admin Dashboard. Members can edit content, promotions, and customer data. They have access to the Top Videos report and to the Pause/Cancel Reasons report, but not to other site analytics. Members have access to Bumpers. They do not have access to banking and payout information. Members cannot add/modify new Admins or Team Members.
  • Contributor - Can only access the Content portion of the Admin Dashboard (Videos, Extras, Live Events, Collections, and Categories). This role is intended to help manage the curation of content.

Add a new Admin/team member

Only the Owner and Admins of a Vimeo OTT site are able to add new team members and their access permissions.

  1. Access the Admin dashboard and navigate to Manage > Team. Screenshot: mceclip0.png
  2. Click Invite +on the right side of the page. Type in the email address of the desired team member, select their role, and click Add to send them an email invite. Screenshot: mceclip1.png

Change a team member’s role

To change an existing team member’s role:

  1. Navigate to Manage, then Team
  2. Click on the drop-down menu on the right side of the team member’s listing on the team management page. Select one of the following:
  • Contributor:Change the selected team member to the Contributor role.
  • Member:Change the selected team member to the Member role.
  • Admin:Change the selected team member to the Admin role
  • Set as Owner: Transfer ownership of your account from you to the selected team member. ⚠️Note:Each account can only have one owner, so only do this if you no longer wish to own your site (e.g., you leave the organization hosting the site).
  • Remove from team: The team member will be removed and can no longer edit your site or see your status.

Manage the number of seats on your Vimeo account

This feature requires a Starter, Standard, or Advanced plan. If you have an Enterprise account and need more seats, contact your account manager.

Not sure which plan type you have? check “Membership” In the upper left corner of your account settings.

As your team grows, you may find you need to add more team members to your Vimeo account to help manage your videos. You can assign up to 200 seats to your account. If you require more than 200 seats, you will need to upgrade to an Enterprise plan.

At this time, only the Vimeo accountowner can add more seats and make purchases for the account. If you need to buy multiple seats, you must do so via vimeo.com; purchasing multiple seats via the iOS and Android apps is not supported.

  • Add seats at checkout
  • Purchase add-on seats for your account
  • Remove a seat from your account

Purchase add-on seats for your account

If you are the owner of the Vimeo account, you can purchase additional seats for your account at any time throughout your billing cycle. This will increase the number of people you can invite to help manage your videos (admins and contributors).

💡Tip: If a team member only needs viewer permissions, you can send them an invite at no additional cost. Doing so will not increase your video limit but it will count towards your 200-seat limit.

Be advised that add-on seat purchases are non-refundable.

If you’ve run out of seats, you will be prompted to purchase more seats if you attempt to invite an admin or contributor from your team management page, or share a folder or video with them. Click Purchase seats to complete the purchase and invite.

Screenshot: team_mgmt_-_run_out_of_seats.png

You can also purchase additional seats on your billing settings page:

  1. In the bottom section of the billing settings, you will see how many seats you currently have. Click Add seats.
  2. A modal window will open. Select the number of seats you wish to purchase.
  3. Select your payment method and review the payment details. Note that the amount due is pro-rated based on the remaining time in your current billing cycle.
  4. Click Complete purchase.

Once the purchase is complete, you can invite team members to your Vimeo account as either admins or contributors.

Remove a seat from your account

⚠️Note: Vimeo Starter, Standard, and Advanced plans are available on a monthly or yearly subscription basis. At this time, onlyMonthly subscribers can delete seats from their accounts. If you are on an annual plan, please contact us for assistance.

With a Monthly plan, you can remove seats from your account if they are no longer being used by anyone on your team. If you remove seats from your plan, your current video cap will decrease.

Removing seats from your account will reduce your subscription renewal price, but note that it will not impact your current billing cycle. We cannot issue refunds for individual seats or add-on purchases.

To remove seats from your account:

  1. Go to your billing settings page.
  2. In the bottom section, you will see your account’s seat allocation. Click Delete seats under “Unassigned.” Screenshot: delete_seats.png
  3. Choose how many unassigned seats you wish to remove. You will see the amount due at the renewal update as you adjust the number.
  4. Click Delete seats and confirm the seat deletion.

Opening and logging into a Vimeo account via Apple ID

You can create and log into your Vimeo account via your Apple ID. Here are some frequently asked questions about logging in and managing your account when using your Apple ID.

  • How do I create a Vimeo account with my Apple ID?
  • Do I need to set a password for my Vimeo account if I sign up with Apple ID?
  • What happens if I select “Hide my email” when signing up with Apple ID?
  • What happens if I change my private relay email address on Apple?
  • If I selected “Hide my email” at signup, can I switch to logging in with my email address and a password instead?

How do I create a Vimeo account with my Apple ID?

You can create a Vimeo account using your Apple ID either on a desktop browser or via the Vimeo mobile app.

Create a Vimeo account via Apple ID using a desktop browser
  1. On vimeo.com, go to the upper right corner and select Log in.
  2. In the modal window that opens, you will see multiple login options. Choose Log in with Apple.
  3. Enter the email address associated with your Apple ID.
  4. Select Continueto confirm you wish to continue using Vimeo with your Apple ID.
  5. You will now have a Vimeo account connected to your Apple ID.
Create a Vimeo account via Apple ID using the Vimeo iOS app
  1. Launch the Vimeo or Vimeo Create iOS app.
  2. If using the Vimeo app, select the default avatar icon in the upper right corner, then select Join Vimeo before moving to step 3.
  3. Select Continue with Apple.
  4. You will see a prompt to create an account for Vimeo using your Apple ID. You may also see the option to Share my email or Hide my email. Read about this below or on Apple’s support site. Choose which one you prefer, then select Continue.

Screenshot: Screenshot_2022-11-02_at_11.34.47_AM.png

  1. You will be logged into a Vimeo account via your Apple ID and can proceed with using the app.

Do I need to set a password for my Vimeo account if I signed up with Apple ID?

If you joined Vimeo using the Sign in with Apple feature, we recommend setting a password for your Vimeo account. This will allow you to perform certain actions on your account that require a Vimeo password.

This step will also ensure that you’ll be able to maintain access to your Vimeo account separately from your Apple ID in the future.

To set a password:

  1. Go to your account settings.
  2. Click Password on the left sidebar.
  3. Click on the Change Password link.

You will be prompted to enter a new password and confirm it.

Screenshot: web_4__password_reset_.png

What happens if I select “Hide my email” when signing up with Apple ID?

When initially joining Vimeo via the Sign in with Apple feature on iOS, you can choose to share your email address with Vimeo or keep it private via the Hide My Email option.

Screenshot: Screenshot_2022-11-02_at_11.34.47_AM.png

In that case, we will only have access to a unique and randomized email address provided by Apple. Vimeo will not be aware of your email address.

If you choose to do this, all emails we send to you will be sent to the assigned private relay email address and then forwarded to your email address. These emails may include critical account notifications and other email messages from Vimeo.

Read about the Sign in with Apple feature on Apple’s Support site.

What happens if I change my private relay email address on Apple?

If you turn off email forwarding or change your private relay email address on Apple, you shouldfirstupdate your email address on Vimeo.Otherwise, you may lose access to your Vimeo account without any way of recovery.

To update the email address used to log into your Vimeo account:

  1. Go to youraccount settings
  2. Select Account on the left-hand side.
  3. Select Edit next to your private relay email address.

Read about the Sign in with Apple feature at Apple’s Support site.

If I selected “Hide my email” at signup, can I switch to logging in with my email address and a password instead?

If you wish to log into Vimeo with your direct email address instead of your Apple ID, you will need to go to your account settings and edit your email address. This ensures we have your direct email address and that you will be able to log into your account using the same email address. This also allows us to quickly locate your account if you contactour support team.

To see the exact private email address we received from Apple, and to manage other accounts created with Apple Sign-In, follow the instructions on Apple’s Support site.

Profile page FAQ

For Enterprise accounts with Workspaces: When an account is converted to a Workspace, the ability to manage the Profile Page is lost. For more information, visit Troubleshooting: I can’t visit my Profile Page after becoming a Workspace

  • How can I get my most recent videos to appear first?
  • I am seeing the incorrect number of videos on my Profile page. Why is this happening?
  • I want to add a video via the “Add Video” module. However, the video is not showing up.
  • I removed a section. What will happen to the order of my video sections on the profile page?
  • What are the categories at the top of profile pages and how can I edit them?
  • How do you highlight specific video comments?
  • How can I enable my videos to be automatically added to my profile page?

How can I get my most recent videos to appear first?

Videos default to appear in chronological order based on upload date unless you have made changes to the profile page such as manually moving videos or adding sections. You may need to scroll down to the bottom of the profile page to find the latest videos or select the Load more button at the bottom of the profile to find them. From there, you can drag and drop the videos to the desired order.

I am seeing the incorrect number of videos on my Profile page. Why is this happening?

There are multiple reasons that may cause videos not to appear on your Profile page. See below for a few examples:

  • Videos will only appear if they are Public. Whether they will be shown or not to the visitor depends on the visitor’s viewing preference and the rating they have set for themselves.
  • You might have disabled the “Automatically add videos” option. If that is the case, you can click on the Add video module to manually add them to your page.
  • If your viewing preference is set to not see mature content, then no videos will be shown on the profile page - even if they are your own.

I want to add a video via the “Add Video” module. However, the video is not showing up.

It’s important to note that private videos will not appear immediately. If you update your private videos to Public, it may take a few moments to appear. If after 15 minutes the video does not appear, please reach out to oursupport team.

If you’re not seeing your public videos at all via that module, reach out to oursupport team with the video URL so that we can look into it.

I removed a section. What will happen to the order of my video sections on profile page?

Once you remove a section, the videos in this section will become part of the previous section above. If it is the first section that is deleted, the videos stay where they are.

What are the categories at the top of profile pages and how can I edit them?

The labels across the top of your profile are the categories associated with your videos. Clicking on any single label will sort the grid accordingly. You can addcategories to your videos in video settings.

How do you highlight specific video comments?

If there are comments on your video, then you will see a “Featured Comment” button when you hover over the video. Clicking on that will give you the option to choose a comment to highlight on your profile page.

How can I enable my videos to be automatically added to my profile page?

By default, all of your public videos will be added to your profile page automatically. If you have disabled this setting, follow these steps to enable it:

  1. Select Add video.
  2. In the lower-left corner of the module that opens, toggle on Automatically add public videos. This setting will save automatically.

Provisioning existing Vimeo users to your team

Once you claim your company’s domain with SSO or provision all your employees with SCIM, you may find that you have many users who already had accounts on Vimeo

Here is what they can expect:

  • The next time they log in, they will use SSO
  • They will not lose any of their existing Vimeo content. Their content will continue to be stored in their Vimeo account and they can use the team switcher to switch between both accounts.

We recommend you migrate their content so it can be centrally managed with your Enterprise account as well. If you want to migrate their content, reach out to your Account Manager to request a content migration.

Saving your credit card information on Vimeo OTT

We can securely store your payment information for easy checkout on any Vimeo OTT-powered site. Note that this is also required in order to add customers to your site.

Why would I save my credit card on Vimeo OTT?

Saving your credit card on Vimeo OTT allows you to quickly purchase your favorite Vimeo OTT content. It also allows you to use the Add Customer tool.

We understand how cumbersome it can be to enter your credit card each time you want to buy a gift or quickly get the next episode of your favorite web show. Now, if you’re logged into Vimeo OTT, you can save your credit card for fast purchasing.

⚠️Note:If you have a Vimeo OTT account and are logged out on the buy page, and you enter your Vimeo OTT account email address as the purchase address, we will NOT prompt you to save your card for security reasons.

Is saving my credit card secure?

Yes; our credit card processor has been audited by a PCI-certified auditor, and is certified to PCI Service Provider Level 1, the most stringent level of certification available. We enforce HTTPS for all sensitive data on Vimeo OTT, including our public website, the checkout experience, and the user account pages.

How do I save my credit card to my Vimeo OTT account?

You can save your card in two places on Vimeo OTT:

  1. On any Vimeo OTT powered checkout form - Click the Save this card checkbox at the bottom of the receipt after purchasing from any checkout form powered by Vimeo OTT.
  2. Your Vimeo OTT payment settings page - To add a new card or manage a stored one, navigate to Account > Billing > Charges. Click Add card to add credit card information.

Screenshot: add_card.png

Secure your account with two-factor authentication

Vimeo supports two-factor authentication (2FA) in order to provide an additional layer of security to your account. We recommend enabling 2FA by either setting up an authenticator app or using your email to retrieve a security code when you log in. Although it’s best to keep 2FA enabled, this article also includes steps for deactivating it within your security settings.

💡Tip:You need to log into your Vimeo account to access the security settings links outlined in this article. If you are unable to access into your Vimeo account, visit ‘I can’t access my account’. If you are locked out of your account after too many 2FA attempts, read below at ‘I am locked out of my account after too many attempts’.

  • How to enable or disable two-factor authentication (2FA)
  • Two-Factor authentication Login Flow
  • Why am I not receiving the 2FA code?
  • I am locked out of my account after too many attempts

How to enable or disable two-factor authentication (2FA)

2FA - Email
  1. Go to Security Settings.
  2. Select 2FA and choose Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) - Email.
  3. You will be prompted to verify your email address if you haven’t already.
  4. Save settings to enable two-factor authentication for your next login.
2FA - Authenticator app
  1. Go to Security Settings.
  2. Select 2FA and choose Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) - Authenticator.
  3. Once you choose this option, a modal will pop up with these setup instructions:
  • Download an authenticator app (e.g. Google authenticator, Authy, or other).
  • Open your chosen authenticator app and scan the QR code or manually enter the security code shown.
  • Verify your app with the provided 6-digit security code.
  1. Save settings to enable two-factor authentication for your next login.
Do not use 2FA
  1. Go to Security Settings.
  2. Select 2FA and select Do not use Two-Factor Authentication (2FA).
  3. Save settings to opt-out of 2FA. You still may choose to enable 2FA in the future to add an extra layer of security to your account.

Two-factor authentication login flow

Once 2FA has been enabled, logging in will take an extra step. Below is what you can expect to see when logging in with 2FA by email or an authenticator app.

2FA - Email
  1. Log in to Vimeo with your email and password as usual.
  2. You will be prompted to enter the security code that was sent to your email.
  3. If you need a new code, you may request one to be resent.
  4. If there have been too many login attempts, you can try again later.
2FA - Authenticator
  1. Log in to Vimeo with your email and password as usual.
  2. You will be prompted to enter the security code from your authenticator app.
  3. Open your app (i.e. Google Authenticator, Authy, or other) to retrieve the code.
  4. If needed, you may request a new code to be emailed instead.
  5. If there have been too many login attempts, you can try again later.

Why am I not receiving the 2FA code?

Your email program may have either marked them as spam or isn’t accepting them. You may need to whitelist @vimeo.com as a safe sender in your email program. Once you have cleared up the issue, go ahead and request a new email. If you find our messages in your spam filter, simply whitelist the message afterward and you should be set. If the issue persists, contact us.

I am locked out of my account after too many attempts

As a security precaution, we temporarily block users who have a series of failed login attempts. Just wait for 15 minutes and you should be able to get back in.

Please note that if you continue to make attempts to log in while the account is blocked, the system will restart the 15-minute wait each time. Also, resetting the password will not expedite the process of accessing your account.

If you’re still seeing the message after 15 minutes have passed, please contact us

Sign up for a Vimeo OTT Seller Account

You can sign up for a free Vimeo OTT Seller account at any time from the Vimeo OTT homepage.

  1. Click Get Started at the top of the Vimeo OTT homepage to access thesign-up page. Screenshot: mceclip0.png
  2. Fill out the signup form with the requested information and set a password for your account.
  3. When completed, click Start Selling.You will receive an email confirming your account creation.

💡Tip: Add ‘ottsupport@vimeo.com’ & ‘sell@vimeo.com’ to your contact list to help prevent emails from Vimeo OTT from being sent to your email’s spam or junk folders.

Standard Connect for Select Markets on Vimeo OTT

⚠️Note: Currently only available for Brazil.

Our existing payment integration on the platform is not available in all countries. In order for our platform to open support within more countries, we now offer OTT using Stripe Standard Connect. You will find below how Seller experience will vary between Stripe Standard Connect and our default payment processor.

Onboarding

You will still need to first Join on Vimeo OTT and select the country your business is registered in. Once you have completed filling out preliminary information about your business and your bank details, you can select Complete Payout Set up.

You’ll notice there’s an additional action item required at the top of your payout page. Click Go To Stripe to finalize the verification process; this will redirect you to Stripe’s onboarding form.

With Standard Connect, you can change your business and bank information at any time on your own by logging into your Stripe account and going to Business details.

If you have any issues with verification or updating your credentials, please contact Stripe Support.

Customer (Subscribers/ Viewers) Support

When you use Vimeo OTT to sell your video content, we’ve got your back on customer support. We strive to reply and help your customers as quickly and effectively as we can. A customer will wait no longer than 24 hours for a reply from the Vimeo OTT support staff for technical support.

With Standard Connect, you now can provide direct support for any billing issues that come up.

Our team is here to help with the first touch and then we will forward them directly to your preferred support email for billing issues only.

Payouts & Fees

You will receive daily payouts when your customers purchase from your site. Vimeo does not hold any funds, however, Stripe will withhold processing fees from customer purchases. You can review those fees here.

Given that Vimeo does not issue payouts for Standard, our fees are deducted differently:

  • Subscription (SVOD)
  • $1 / subscriber / month
  • Charged on credit card at the end of the month for previous month’s sales
  • Buy & Rent (TVOD)
  • 10% + 50¢ / transaction
  • API Fulfillments & Add Customer
  • $1 / unit
  • Promos
  • 100 FREE / month $1 for each additional Note: If you issue a promo for 100% off, we will still charge $1/subscriber fee

If you have any issues with your payout, please contact Stripe Support.

Chargebacks

With Standard, you are able to manage any disputes that come up on your Stripe dashboard. Vimeo does not handle chargebacks on your behalf.

Any fees or withholding of funds associated with a dispute may be deducted from your sales.

Taxes

Vimeo will not calculate, withhold, or remit sales tax on customer purchases. It will be imperative for you to work with a tax professional in your country to understand and meet your tax obligations.

Vimeo is unable to provide tax consultation.

Subscription and Transaction Analytics

Your subscriber analytics will be reflected on the main OTT Dashboard pageand the Subscriber report however transactional (TVOD) purchases will not appear on the Buy & Rent report. To track your Purchase/Rental transactions, you will need to check the Customer CSV.

Troubleshooting: Charged twice for my subscription

If you have enabled the automatic renewal of your subscription, the payment method provided must be up to date to charge successfully.

In the case that your payment is failing, update your payment method.

Troubleshooting: I can’t edit my profile page after adding a Workspace

After your team’s account is updated to an Organizations and Workspaces structure, you may notice that you are no longer able to make changes to your team’sprofile page. This article explains why this happens and what to expect.

  • Why can’t I edit my profile page?
  • How your profile page will behave

What’s preventing me from editing my profile page?

This is a known technical limitation of the new Organizations and Workspaces account structure.

The ability to edit a profile page was previously tied to a specific “Team Owner” permission. In the new Workspaces structure, that role no longer exists, which means no user has the permission to edit the profile page settings. This change is permanent.

How your profile page will behave

The behavior of your profile page depends on its state before your account was updated to the new structure.

  • If your profile page was turned off, it will remain off permanently. You will not be able to turn it on.
  • If your profile page was turned ON: Your profile page will remain on permanently, and you will not be able to edit its contents.
  • If you had the “Automatically add public videos” setting activated, it will also remain activated permanently, and all new public videos will continue to be added to your profile page.

Our team is aware of this limitation and is investigating potential improvements for the future.

Troubleshooting: Payment fails when purchasing or renewing a Vimeo plan

This article discusses how to troubleshoot if your payment fails when you are purchasing or renewing a Vimeo plan.

  • Understanding specific error messages
  • How to troubleshoot a failed payment
  • How do I report an issue with my subscription payment?

Understanding specific error messages

Error: Some information could not be verified. Please check the information or try a different card.

If you’re receiving this error message, then it’s likely that there’s something wrong with the details of your payment method, such as the billing address. We suggest checking what your bank has on file and updating it if necessary, then retrying.

⚠️Note: If you are having trouble renewing an existing Vimeo plan, you can also try changing your payment method.

How to troubleshoot a failed payment

If your payment information is not being accepted during the payment process, there are a few steps you can take to troubleshoot the issue:

  • Double-check the expiration date: Verify that you have entered the correct expiration date for your credit card. If your card has recently been renewed, make sure you are using the updated expiration date.
  • Verify the zip code: Ensure that the zip code you entered during the payment process matches the billing address associated with your credit card. If you have recently moved or changed your billing address, update the zip code accordingly.
  • Check the CVV: The CVV (Card Verification Value) is a three-digit or four-digit security code located on the back of most credit cards. Make sure you have entered the CVV correctly. If your card has a scratched or illegible CVV, contact your credit card issuer for assistance.
  • If you are based in India, ensure international transactions are enabled on your payment method. Please check with your bank or card issuer to confirm this information.
  • Clear cache:Clearing your browser’s cache removes temporary data that your browser has stored. This can often resolve common issues with a website’s loading or formatting.
  • Incognito mode: Try using an incognito (or private) browsing window to complete the process. Switching to a different web browser can also resolve the issue.

⚠️Note: It’s always best to contact your bank or card issuer for more information if you are unable to add, change, or save your credit card details to your account.

How do I report an issue with my subscription payment?

Please contact Vimeo Support using our contact form if:

  • You have tried all the steps above, and your card still doesn’t work.
  • You were charged twice for the same transaction.

Please include the exact error message you received in our contact form.

How do I reset my password?

To reset your password, visit theForgot your password? link. Please be aware that you must be logged out of any Vimeo account for this link to function.

To reset your password, enter the email address associated with your Vimeo account. You will then receive a password reset link via email, which you can click to choose a new password. Allow a few minutes for the email to arrive.

I’m not receiving the password reset email.

Check your spam folder if the password reset email doesn’t appear after a few minutes. If you still don’t see the email, pleasecontact us for further assistance.

The password reset email is not working.

If you requested a password reset more than once, make sure you’re only clicking on the most recent password reset email. If you are still having trouble resetting your password after this process, please contact us for assistance.

I no longer have access to the email associated with my Vimeo account.

If you’re unable to access the email address associated with your account, please follow these steps:

  1. Go tothis form. This link will not work if you are currently logged into a Vimeo account.
  2. After filling out the form, click the Reset Password isn’t working link on the second page to contact us for further assistance.

On the contact form, please provide us with as much information as possible to prove that you are the true owner of the account.

⚠️Note: Do not include your account password, full credit card number, or other sensitive information.

I don’t remember the email address used on my Vimeo account.

If you don’t know what email address is associated with your Vimeo account,fill out this form to reach out to our support team, and we’ll help you find it as soon as possible.

⚠️Note:The above link does not work if you are logged into a Vimeo account.

Provide as much information as possible so that we can verify your account ownership.

My account is temporarily locked after failed login attempts.

If you’ve attempted to log in to Vimeo too many times with an incorrect password, your account will be temporarily locked. You can reset your password or wait for the temporary block to be lifted before trying again. For additional login assistance, pleasecontact us.

What information should I provide to help locate my account?

Locate your account with a charge on your card

If you have a charge on your card from Vimeo, we can use the information from the charge to help find your account. We’ll need the exact amount charged, the date, and the last four digits of the card in question.Never provide your full credit card number in an email.

For Google Play purchases: Go to Google Pay and log in, and then go to the Activity page. The transaction ID should look like this: GPA.1234-5678-1234-56789.

You can send this information to us through the Contact Form, selecting Billing and Membership from the drop-down menu, and then “Unknown Charge/Account Lookup.”

Locate your account with a link to a video

If you have a link to a video that you’re sure is from your account, we can locate your account with this information. Please provide the link to us using this form (note that this link does not work if you are logged into a Vimeo account).

⚠️Note:We are unable to locate an account for you by using a first/last name, a company name, or a domain from an email address without the exact user name (for example, @vimeo.com).

How do I find my Vimeo account’s email address if I signed up via a third party?

If you created your Vimeo account using a third-party service like Google,Facebook, orApple,fill out this form to reach out to our Support team and provide the email address used to log into that third-party service.

If you used the Apple Sign-In feature “Hide my email”, be aware that we only have a randomized email address saved on our end. To find that randomized email address and manage other accounts created with Apple Sign-In, follow the instructions on Apple’s Support sitehere. Read about this feature at Opening and logging into a Vimeo account via Apple ID.

My account has been deactivated.

If you attempt to log into your account and see a message saying it has been deactivated, it might be that your account has violated Vimeo’s Terms of Service and/or Vimeo Guidelines. Search your inbox for a notification email from Vimeo, which would include the reason why your account may have been terminated.

Troubleshooting: Vimeo charged me and I don’t know why

This article discusses what to do if you find an unrecognized charge on your card from Vimeo.

  • What caused this charge to appear?
  • How to solve an unrecognized charge from Vimeo

What caused this charge to appear?

If you see a charge from Vimeo that you don’t recognize:

  • Check all your known email addresses to see if there is a Vimeo account tied to them. A subscription may have renewed on an account you haven’t used recently.
  • Check if you previously signed up for a free trial. If you didn’t cancel the trial before the end date, it would have auto-renewed into a paid plan, causing Vimeo to charge the payment method you provided.
  • When you sign up for your free trial, you will see a notice on the checkout page indicating the day the trial ends, and that you will be charged if you do not cancel the trial before that date.
  • The checkout page also explains how to cancel the free trial if you prefer to end the subscription before auto-renew occurs.

How to solve an unrecognized charge from Vimeo

Contact Support with information regarding the transaction. You can reduce your wait time and increase our chances of finding your account more quickly by providing the following in your initial message:

  • The date of the transaction
  • The last 4 numbers of the card that was charged
  • A screenshot of the charge
  • Never provide your full card number. We would never request any sensitive information. Be sure to crop or blank out any sensitive information on your statements.

View your purchase history and download invoices

Find all your Vimeo purchases—subscriptions, on-demand content, and more—in your billing settings. Here’s how to view your purchase history and download invoices.

  • View your purchase history and invoices
  • Download or print an invoice
  • Purchase history from the Vimeo app
  • What happened to receipts?

View your purchase history and invoices

To access your invoices, log in to your Vimeo account and follow these steps:

  1. Open the account dropdown menu in the upper right corner and select Settings Screenshot: The vimeo main navigation dropdown menu opened with the Settlings option highlighted. It’s the first option below Invite members.
  2. Go to Billing > Purchases
  3. Select a year from the dropdown menu on the right

What you’ll see: Each invoice shows your plan details, pricing, and regional VAT/GST information for purchases made after 2026.

Note: Only paid invoices are available for download. Pre-checkout invoices, pro-forma, and quotes are not offered for self-serve plans.

Download or print an invoice

Download invoices directly from your billing settings:

  1. Go to Settings > Billing > Purchases
  2. Find the purchase you need and select Download
  3. The invoice downloads as a PDF to your device

To print: Open the PDF and select Print from your PDF viewer or browser. You can also select Save as PDF to store another copy.

Purchase history from the Vimeo app

Yes, you can view your purchase history—but you’ll need to check it through the platform where you made the purchase.

Apple/iTunes purchases: See Apple Support’s instructions on how to view your order history.

Google Play purchases: See Google Play Support’s guide on how to view your order history.

What happened to receipts?

In 2026, we replaced receipts with itemized invoices to meet global accounting and tax standards across all regions. Invoices provide more detail information than receipts, including a full VAT/GST breakdown where applicable.

Are invoices sent via email?

No. Invoices aren’t included in automated emails. To access your invoices, log in to your Vimeo account and download them from Settings > Billing > Purchases.

Need to fix a billing detail? You can update your billing information in Settings > Billing. If a recent invoice was generated with incorrect information, contact Support for a refund. Then update your billing details and sign up again to generate a correct invoice.

Will the invoice show my business name?

Your invoice displays your Vimeo Account Name by default.

Do invoices support different languages?

Invoices are available in English only.

Invoices do support different currencies and automatically include the applicable tax information (VAT/GST) based on your region.

Enterprise and custom contract customers

If you’re an Enterprise customer or have a custom contract, log in to the invoice payment portal to access your invoices. Your billing process is separate from self-serve plans.

Vimeo account security tips

Vimeo values your privacy and security and would never ask you for your account password or other sensitive information. If you receive an email or a phone call from someone claiming to be from Vimeo and asking for your password or sensitive information, it is not a legitimate request.

  • Tips to protect your Vimeo account
  • Best practices for protecting your data

Tips to protect your Vimeo account

Here are some tips to protect your Vimeo account:

  • Never share your password with anyone, not even someone you trust.
  • Use a strong password that is unique to your Vimeo account.
  • Enable two-factor authentication (2FA) for your Vimeo account.
  • Be careful about what links you click on in emails or on social media.
  • Keep your software updated, including your web browser and antivirus software.

If you believe your Vimeo account has been compromised, immediately change your password and contact Vimeo customer support.

Best practices for protecting your data

Use a password manager to generate and store strong, unique passwords for your online accounts.

  • Be careful about what information you share online, especially on social media.
  • Only download files from trusted sources.
  • Keep your computer’s operating system and software up to date.
  • Use a firewall and antivirus software.
  • Be aware of phishing scams and phishing emails.

By following these tips, you can help to keep your data safe and your Vimeo account secure. If you have any questions about protecting your Vimeo account, please contact Vimeo customer support. While contacting support, send the email_header and/or screenshot of the email receivedfor our reference.

Vimeo OTT pricing breakdown

Vimeo OTT is a platform that allows content creators to launch their own subscription-based video-on-demand (VOD) services, providing the tools to host, manage, and monetize their content directly to consumers. Vimeo OTT is a revenue-share-based service and requires no upfront costs or subscription fees. You can check the completepricing plans for Vimeo OTT.

  • Basic Fees
  • Video Uploading
  • Extra Features

Basic Fees

  • Subscription (SVOD)
  • $1 / subscriber/month + merchant fees 2.5% + 30¢
  • Buy & Rent (TVOD)
  • 10% + 50¢ / transaction

For annual subscriptions, the fee will be $12 upfront per annual subscriber ($1 x 12 months).

All the fees that you might encounter will be clearly broken down in your dashboard. Here is an example of what you might see when you log in to your dashboard and hover over the Expenses heading at the top: Screenshot: image showing the different fees structure : Merchant fees, VHX rev share, fixed fees and fulfillment fees and listing out the charges.

The fees are defined as follows:

  • Fee
  • Definition
  • Fee Charged**
  • Merchant Fees
  • Credit card and Payment Wallet processing fees for purchases made through the platform for SVOD (subscription) products (For TVOD (Buy/Rent) products, the merchant fee is included with the Revenue share and Fixed fee.)
  • Fee deducted from Payout
  • VHX Rev Share
  • 10% fee retained by Vimeo for the sale of TVOD products (Buy/Rent)*
  • Fee deducted from Payout
  • Fixed Fees
  • $1 per subscriber per month for SVOD (including subscribers who redeem a 100% off promo) and 50¢ per transaction for TVOD products retained by Vimeo OTT*
  • Fee deducted from Payout
  • Fulfillment Fees
  • Fees associated with purchases fulfilled by API or branded apps. This includes users added for free.
  • Fee charged to CC on file

*Fees may vary across Enterprise contracts

**Not applicable to Standard Connect

Fees may be incurred if you exceed 100 redeemed coupons or distribute more than 100 screeners.

Subscription (SVOD) fees are not charged for users on a free trial. Subscription promos are generally applied only after the free trial period ends, and the user begins paying the standard subscription fees. This is only different if the user originally signed up through an app. This is because of a restriction in our ability to differentiate between users with paid subscriptions and those on a trial when sign-up occurred via an app.

Enterprise sellers may have different fees depending on their contract terms.

Our fees may vary for products offered in currencies other than USD due to fluctuating foreign exchange rates.

Learn in detail about understanding the payout statements, creating and editing subscription products, and creating and selling purchase/rental products on OTT.

What is the logic behind the order of videos displayed on my profile page?

For Enterprise accounts with Workspaces: When an account is converted to a Workspace, the ability to manage the Profile Page is lost. For more information, visit Troubleshooting: I can’t visit my Profile Page after becoming a Workspace

If you do not have any sections on your profile page:

  • The manually positioned clips will appear first. This includes rearranged videos.
  • Then the remaining videos will be shown in the order of their uploaded date (newest to oldest).
  • From the remaining videos, all removed videos will be filtered out. This consists of videos removed from the profile page by clicking on the Remove from profile button and videos that have had their privacy setting or rating changed.

You can also choose to reposition clips and this will take precedence. For example, if you upload new videos they will be shown after these specifically positioned videos.

If you have multiple sections with no videos arranged:

  • Uploaded videos will appear in the last section as the first video.

If you have multiple sections with videos arranged in the last section:

  • Videos will appear after the rearranged/pinned videos in the last section.

⚠️Note: Only public videos and public trailer videos will be shown on the profile page.

Where can I find my support ticket requests?

To navigate to your support ticket requests:

  1. Select the question mark(?)symbol in the upper right-hand corner of your Vimeo home page.
  2. Click on your Vimeo avatar on the top navigation bar and select Requests.
  3. You can now check your requests under the My requests tab. You can also sort through the Status drop-down on the right side to filter your requests.

About Acquia DAM integration

You can integrate your Vimeo account with Acquia DAM to help streamline the video workflow between creative teams and marketing channels. This article discusses details about the integration and how it works.

Video overview

Watch the video below to see an overview of how the integration works.

Acquia DAM integration overview

Acquia DAM serves as a secure and central hub for managing video files. This integration automatically syncs new and updated external videos from Acquia DAM to your Vimeo account, eliminating manual uploads. This ensures that your team and customers will have immediate access to the latest video content directly from Acquia DAM.

  • When a video is uploaded or a new version is created in the Acquia DAM, the integration automatically uploads or updates the video on Vimeo.

  • A link to the corresponding video’s settings page on Vimeo can be automatically added back to the asset’s metadata in Acquia DAM.
  • Edit in your software, upload video files to Acquia DAM, and the integration automatically sends final, external facing videos to Vimeo.

About Create’s integration with Wix

The Create integration with Wix allows website owners to access Vimeo’s full-featured, advanced editing experience via an iframe on top of the Wix site. See the Wix hub page to read more about this integration.

Wix users have access to a wider variety of templates within Vimeo’s creation and editing experience in comparison to the selected template collection on Wix. As a Wix user, you can create yourfirst two (2) videos on Wix using the native Wix Video Maker. If you wish to create additional videos on Wix, you’ll need to create and connect a Vimeo account.

⚠️ Note: Your access will be blocked in all video creation modes on Wix until you log in or create a new profile on Vimeo when attempting to create a third video.

After connecting a Vimeo account to your Wix site, you’ll be prompted to choose between Wix Video Maker or Create before starting to create your third and further videos. If you choose Create, the Create iFrame will launch on top of the Wix page.

How to access Create within Wix

First, you must create a free Wix account and sign in. You can access and experience the following tools on your free Wix account:

  • (Wix) Social Media Marketing
  • (Wix) Media Manager
  • (Wix) Editor
  • (Wix Button) Explore Templates On Vimeo

⚠️ Note:You will need to create your first two videos within Wix Video Maker and then start creating the third video to initiate the Vimeo account connection process.

How to make a video using Create within Wix

  1. Log into your Wix account.
  2. In the left-hand side navigation menu, select Marketing & SEO.
  3. Select Social Media Marketing.
  4. Select Quick Actions in the top-right corner.
  5. Select Create video with Vimeo.
  6. This will bring you to the video customization workflow.

In the video customization workflow:

  1. Select the photos and videos that you would like to add to your video from your device. You can add up to 15. If you would like to add text to your video, add in the corresponding text boxes.
  2. Select Next.
  3. Choose a video style, the layout orientation of your video, color palette, and font.
  4. Select Next.
  5. Select a music track or select No Music.
  6. Select Next.
  7. Add your business information and logo. Select whether you would like this information to appear at the end of your video.
  8. Select Apply and Preview to apply your customizations and preview the video.
  9. If you would like to make any changes to your video based on the preview, select Back to Editing.
  10. If you would like to save your video, select Save and Share.

Additional notes:

  • Create’s watermark will not be displayed on these videos (including Basic and Free accounts).
  • You can create an unlimited number of videos for Wix (including Basic and Free accounts which usually are limited to 10 videos).

About restrictions and requirements for publishing to social

This article discusses the restrictions and requirements for publishing videos on social media platforms such as Facebook, LinkedIn, YouTube, Twitter (X), Shopify, and TikTok.

  • Restrictions
  • Facebook
  • LinkedIn
  • Additional Features
  • Platform Requirements
  • Facebook
  • YouTube
  • Twitter (X)
  • LinkedIn
  • Shopify
  • TikTok

Restrictions

  • Publish to Social is available for Contributors, Contributors +, and Admins on team accounts, and accounts with Workspaces.
  • For Enterprise accounts with Workspaces:Publish to social can be limited by Organization Owners and Admins. Read more at How to edit my Organization’s settings
Facebook

Please note you cannot publish videos to Facebook profiles but you can still publish them to Facebook pages. Don’t worry — anything posted before August 1, 2018, on your Facebook profile will not be removed! Another note on Facebook: you can only connect your Vimeo account to a maximum of 25 pages at a time.

LinkedIn

Similar to Facebook, it is only possible to publish videos to LinkedIn Company pages. Publishing native videos to personal LinkedIn profiles is not currently supported. Be sure to connect to the LinkedInapp to publish videos to LinkedIn Company pages. If you want to stream live to LinkedIn, you will have to connect to LinkedIn Live.

Additional Features

When using the publish to social feature, only the video file will be published to each social platform. Other features (such as captions and thumbnails) and Vimeo-specific settings such as video privacy, video interaction tools, or any other type of player customization will not be transferred. Additional video features will need to be managed on each individual site the video is published natively to.

Platform Requirements

Be sure to adhere to the specifications of each social platform, so that you can ensure your videos will successfully publish to social directly from Vimeo:

Facebook
  • Aspect ratio: 16:9 (landscape) or 1:1 (square)
  • Max file size: 4GB
  • Maximum frame rate: 30 fps
YouTube
  • Aspect ratio: 16:9 (YouTube automatically adds black bars to their player in order to accommodate different video sizes)
  • Maximum file size: 128GB
  • Maximum video duration: 12 hours for verified Google accounts
  • When you select YouTube, avoid using angle brackets (< >) in the Description field. This can cause the video to not upload to YouTube.
Twitter (X)
  • Aspect ratio: 16:9, 1.33:1
  • Maximum file size: 512MB
  • Maximum video length: 2:20
LinkedIn
  • Maximum file size: 5GB
  • Minimum file size: 75KB
  • Minimum video duration: 3 seconds
  • Maximum video duration: 10 minutes
  • Resolution range: 256x144 to 4096x2304
  • Aspect ratio: 1:2.4 - 2.4:1
  • Maximum frame rate: 60 fps
Shopify
  • Video length: Up to 60 seconds
  • Video size: Up to 1 GB
  • Video resolution: Up to 4K (4096 x 2160 px)
  • Video file type: .mp4 or .mov
TikTok
  • Aspect ratio: 9:16, 1:1, or 16:9
  • Resolution: One of the following:
  • ≥540x960
  • ≥640x640
  • ≥960x540
  • Duration: 5-60 seconds allowed, 9-15 seconds recommended
  • File size: ≤500 MB
  • File type: .mp4, .mov, .mpeg, .3gp, or .avi
  • Bitrate: ≥516 kbps
  • Need a TikTok for Business account
  • For more information about TikTok video specifications, visit Video Ads Specifications from the TikTok Business Help Center

About the Salesforce Sales Cloud integration with Vimeo

This feature requires an Enterprise plan.

This article discusses how to connect your Vimeo account to Salesforce Sales Cloud.

You can sync your video or event registration form with Sales Cloud. This allows you to gather and evaluate leads from your Vimeo video or event within your desired campaign in Sales Cloud.

After enabling this integration, you can pass Vimeo lead generation data back to Sales Cloud and import Sales Cloud data into Vimeo. You can also sync viewer-level analytics (campaign member status, watch time, polls answered, Q&A) into Sales Cloud.

  • How to enable the Sales Cloud integration
  • How to use the Sales Cloud integration
  • About analytics and the Sales Cloud integration
  • Limitations of the Sales Cloud integration

How to enable the Sales Cloud integration

Follow the steps below to link your Sales Cloud data with Vimeo:

  1. Log in to Vimeo.
  2. Select your Vimeo profile icon, then select Settings to access your account settings.
  3. Navigate toMarketingand select Integrations.
  4. Next to Salesforce Sales Cloud, select Connect. Screenshot: A white rectangular box contains the Salesforce logo (a blue cloud with “salesforce” in white text) and the text “Salesforce Sales Cloud.” To the right, a white button with rounded corners, a blue outline, and blue text says “Connect.” ⚠Note:You must be the account Owner to connect Salesforce Sales Cloud to your Vimeo account.
  5. You will be prompted to log in to your Salesforce Sales Cloudaccountandverify your account via Sales Cloud OAuth.
  6. Once you have successfully verified your account, Salesforce Sales Cloud is Connected in your Marketing settings.
  7. Now, you can sync with Sales Cloud lists when setting up registration forms for live events or videos.

How to use the Sales Cloud integration

See below to learn how to use the integration with Sales Cloud on your live events and videos.

  1. On Salesforce, create a new campaign for your video or live event by selecting Campaigns >New Campaign.
  2. On the registration form for your video or event, select your Sales Cloud campaign from the ’Sync to email list’ option.
  • To access the registration form for a webinar, select the settings gear at the top right of the event settings page and then select“Registration” from the right-hand panel. Screenshot: The gear icon in the top navigation bar is selected to show the setting menu. The “Settings” menu includes sections for “Production” and “Registration.” Under “Registration,” it shows “0 people registered” and a “Manage registrants” button. Below that is a preview of a registration form and a “Customize form” button.
  • To access the registration form for a video, navigate to theInteractivitytab on the left side of the video settings page and select Registration.
  1. Once you have synced a Sales Cloud campaign to your webinar or video, users will be prompted to register via the Vimeo form before watching.

When viewers register via the form, Vimeo will scan their email addresses to see if a Lead or Contact exists in Sales Cloud.

  • If a Lead or Contact exists → Registrant (Salesforce custom object) is created and associated to that lead or Contact record → Registrant will appear in the campaign synced in Vimeo event or video.
  • If a Lead or Contact does notexist, → A New lead is created for the user → A Registrant is created and associated with that lead or Contact record → The Registrant will appear in the campaign synced in Vimeo event or video.

You can also import your existing leads by syncing from a Sales Cloud campaign. Learn how at ’How to add attendees to your live event or webinar via CSV file, CRM, or MAP’.

About analytics and the Sales Cloud integration

To receive viewer-level analytics, you must manually complete the webinar or wait one hour after the webinar autocompletes (autocompletion occurs when you don’t manually complete the webinar, but Vimeo completes it for you).

You can access your Vimeo video and webinar data under the campaign (Vimeo Event ID).

Screenshot: The dashboard interface shows a red arrow pointing from the “Campaigns” tab in the top navigation bar to the “Vimeo Events (6+)” section lower on the page. The “Vimeo Events” section lists six events by ID, Event ID, and Title.

You can view the registrants for each webinar and video. You can drill into the Registrant’s ID to see the lead’s viewer-level analytics. Analytics will appear under theVimeo Events and Registrants custom object.

Screenshot: An the registrant interface for “Vimeo Events” shows a tab for “Vimeo-Event-19” open. Below the main event details, a “Registrants (1)” section is visible, listing one registrant with Lead ID displaying the name of the attendee, Status listed as “Attended Live,” and Watch Time listed as “93%.”

In Related, you’ll find Polls, Q&A, custom, and hidden UTM fields.

Screenshot: The “Related” tab displays sections for “Polls (1)”, “QnA (1)”, and “Registration/Hidden Fields (1)” are visible. The “Polls” section shows one poll with the question “Are you incorporating AI in your roadmap in 2025?” and the answer “Yes.” The “QnA” section shows one question, “What are the trends in the tech industry for 2025?” and the answer “Asked.” The “Registration/Hidden Fields” section shows one field with Type “Registration Field”, Field Name “Industry”, and Value “Technology.”

In Details, you’ll find analytics for watch time % and total video views.

Screenshot: * The “Details” tab displaying details for a registered user. The details include “Vimeo Events ID” “Watch Time (%)” “Status” “Total Views””Registration Date”, “Lead ID”,”Contact ID”, “Created By”, and “Last Modified By” details.

Analytics include:

  • Video/webinar title
  • Registration date
  • Hidden UTM fields. See Track your webinars UTM parameter to learn how.
  • Watch time (%)
  • Registration statuses
  • Invited
  • User registers on the Vimeo form or the Salesforce form
  • Registered
  • User registers on Vimeo or Salesforce form and is matched via email address to a Salesforce Contact or Lead
  • Attended Live
  • Registered guest attends the webinar
  • No Show
  • The user was invited/registered and didn’t attend the webinar or the on-demand recording
  • Q&A (live event only)
  • Polls and answers (live event only)
  • Views (video only)

See Track your webinar’s attendee engagement and analytics to learn how.

Limitations of the Sales Cloud integration

Data sync

Webinar analytics

  • In your webinar timezone, CRM data will first start syncing at midnight. Then, it will continue to sync one hour before the start time, and every 15 minutes between when the webinar begins. CRM data will stop syncing when the webinar ends or exceeds two hours in duration. Therefore, viewers who register later may not be reflected on the platform.
  • Viewer-level analytics sync when you manually complete the webinar, OR one hour after, when the webinar Autocompletes (Autocomplete occurs when you don’t manually complete the webinar, but Vimeo completes it for you). Analytics sync every five minutes in five-minute intervals; analytics should finish syncing after 25 minutes.

Video Analytics

  • Upload time refers to the exact time when the video was uploaded. For example, if you uploaded a video at 6 AM on June 1st, the analytics for this video will sync daily at 7 AM.

Already registered

Currently, if an attendee registers through a Salesforce form, there’s no way for the integration to identify if they’ve registered or not. Therefore, even if the webinar hosts import the Salesforce campaign, attendees will still need to sign in with their email when they select ’Already registered’.

About the Vimeo integration for Bizzabo

This article explores the integration of Vimeo with Bizzabo, enhancing large-scale conferences by providing a seamless attendee experience through advanced features such as end-to-end event management, high-quality video streaming, and detailed analytics.

This integration is available to Vimeo Premium and Enterprise subscribers who also have a Bizzabo membership.

  • Bizzabo integration features
  • Technical information
  • What happens when your stream ends
  • Event privacy settings

Bizzabo integration features

The advantages of this integration include:

  • End-to-end event management: You’ll be able to build a branded event website that acts as the virtual lobby of your event, and manage your agenda, attendees, speakers, exhibitors and sponsors, all on one platform.
  • Native TV-quality viewing experience: Vimeo’s player is embedded within Bizzabo so that your audience can watch your live content in HD on Vimeo’s state-of-the-art player without leaving your event website. You’ll be able to easily manage the stream from Vimeo or Livestream Studio, using any of the built-in tools to switch cameras or add production graphics to brand your video.
  • Customizable user journeys: Bizzabo supports multiple event tracks, allowing you to give your audience the flexibility to choose from several concurrent sessions. You can also set different ticket types to customize the experience for different ticket holders (e.g. VIP-only sessions). Attendees can select from sessions that interest them.
  • Analytics with actionable marketing insights: On Bizzabo’s end, you’ll have access to in-depth aggregate and user-level analytics on attendee engagement, participation in Q&A and polls, and session and speaker ratings so that you can easily see what resonates with your audience and use these insights to inform your post-event marketing strategies. On Vimeo’s end, you’ll be able to see advanced analytics on your video and its performance.

Technical information

For an overview of how embedding a live event works on Vimeo, visit Embed your event on your website. The article will walk you through the various settings you’ll be able to customize, as well as how to get the chat embed code.

What happens when your stream ends

Ending your stream will trigger the final stages of the video archiving process. Your live settings page will also change to the post-live version. The indicator at the top changes to Offline, and your video preview will now link to your archived video’s settings page.

Once your video has gone through the archival process, it appears in your Library on your Vimeo account like any other video.

Event privacy settings

When you create your live event, you’ll be able to select from several privacy options. About privacy settings for live events will walk you through all of them; these settings will apply to wherever the video is embedded, including Bizzabo.

About the Vimeo integration on GoDaddy

This article discusses the integration between Vimeo and GoDaddy, highlighting how users can upload videos directly to their sites, the benefits of connecting their Vimeo account, and the various uploading limits and features available based on account types.

Visit the GoDaddy hub page to read more about this integration.

  • Uploading limits
  • Connecting your Vimeo account to your GoDaddy site
  • Why connect your account?

Uploading limits

You can upload up to three videos without connecting to your Vimeo account; once you’ve reached the limit of three, you’ll be asked to create an account or connect to an existing account. Depending on the level of your account, you’ll be able to then upload additional videos (see details about account types and limitations on Vimeo at ‘Compare Vimeo plans’). When using Vimeo Create, GoDaddy users can create up to one video before needing to connect their Vimeo account.

Connecting your Vimeo account to your GoDaddy site

You can upload up to three videos before you need to connect your GoDaddy and Vimeo accounts. Once you connect your Vimeo account, any videos you uploaded via GoDaddy will be merged into the account you connect. Your videos will appear in both your GoDaddy account (in the media library) and in the Library of your Vimeo account.

To connect your account, follow the step-by-step directions on GoDaddy’s documentation. If you come across any issues with your GoDaddy account, you can contact their support team by visiting the GoDaddy Help Center.

Why connect your account?

Connecting your account gives you customization abilities and added video storage. With a Vimeo Basic account, you can upload up to 500 MB per week or up to a total of 5 GB, whichever comes first. If you need to upload more videos per week or more videos in total, or you want the ability to customize your player or control the privacy of your videos, you may upgrade your Vimeo account for an additional cost. See a breakdown of the available plans at ‘Compare Vimeo plans.’

Connecting a Vimeo account gains you the following features, depending on the Vimeo account level:

  • Up to 7 TB of video storage, and the ability to host and manage all your videos in one place on Vimeo’s Library;
  • Access to Vimeo Create, and the ability to make high-impact videos with your own branding to share on your social channels;
  • The ability to embed and distribute across the web — with robust analytics so you can see how your videos are performing;
  • Customizations options for the embedded player on your site;
  • Privacy controls that let you determine which sites your video can be embedded upon;
  • Marketing and lead generation tools such as custom calls-to-action, end screens, and more.

If you run into any issues or have any questions about using Vimeo on GoDaddy, feel free to contact Vimeo Support.

About the Vimeo integration with an LMS (SCORM and xAPI)

This feature requires an Enterprise plan with Vimeo Central or Streaming.

This article discusses how to integrate Vimeo content with a Learning Management System (LMS) using SCORM and xAPI packages.

Enterprise account Owners and Admins can integrate Vimeo with their LMS by downloading ZIP files for import into SCORM-compliant LMS.

For Enterprise Users with Workspaces: These settings are managed by a Workspace Administrator. For additional information, visit ‘How to edit my Workspace’s settings’.

  • How to configure default LMS settings
  • How to integrate videos with your LMS using SCORM
  • How can learners access Vimeo content within my LMS?

How to configure default LMS settings

Follow these steps to configure default e-learning settings for your account.

  1. Navigate to your team settings page and scroll down to find E-learning.
  2. Now, you can view and configure default settings using these options:
  • Learner management: View the learner IDs that have been passed to Vimeo from your LMS
  • Learner IDs are the IDs that your LMS uses to track your users, and they are shared with Vimeo from your SCORM packages. However, if you choose to gate your videos behind SSO, Vimeo will associate the learner IDs with the corresponding Vimeo users.
  • Technical standard:Choose which e-learning standard you would like to use as your default. Vimeo can support:
  • SCORM 1.2
  • SCORM 2004 v3
  • xAPI (Tin Can)
  • AICC
  • cmi5
  • Scoring method:Choose a default method to calculate the score. Vimeo can support:
  • Percentage watched - Score is equal to the percentage of the video watched.
  • Pass/fail - Score is 100% if the user watches beyond the completion threshold, or score is 0% if the user watches less than the completion threshold
  • Quiz score - Scoring method setting that packages your interactive video as a SCORM file, enabling the LMS to receive and track the learner’s specific results and scores from the in-video questions.
  • Completion percentage threshold (%):Choose a default percentage of a video to consider the video completely watched.

How to integrate videos with your LMS using SCORM

After configuring LMS settings, you can export ZIP files for individual videos, which can then be imported into your LMS.

  1. Navigate to the video settings page by selecting a video from your library.
  2. Select the Sharedropdown. Screenshot: blobid2.png
  3. Click on Publishand selectExport to LMS. Screenshot: Capture d’écran 2025-10-07 à 1.03.45 PM (1).png
  4. Configure your settings as prompted and then select Download to save the ZIP file to your device.
  5. Now you can upload the ZIP file from Vimeo into your LMS course.
  6. Publish your course. The Vimeo content within the ZIP file will be accessible within the course.
  7. As learners interact with your course, results will be stored and analyzed in the LMS course.

How can learners access Vimeo content within my LMS?

Here is how learners can interact with Vimeo content inside the LMS:

  1. First, they will log in to the LMS.
  2. Once they access an assignment containing a Vimeo video, they can watch the video and interact with any other features inside the video player. 💡Tip: If your video includes audio tracks in other languages and the learner’s browser is set to one of those languages, the video player will automatically choose that audio track.
  3. At this point, viewing activity is logged and a numeric grade is calculated based on the implemented algorithm and sent to the LMS gradebook. ⚠️Note: Assignment resubmission is controlled by the LMS. An LMS can allow multiple attempts per lesson, but Vimeo will only allow one score per attempt.
  4. The learner can review their score in the LMS gradebook.
  5. If learners are accessing the video externally without Single Sign-On (SSO), you must set the video privacy to ‘Embed only’, ‘Public’, or ‘Unlisted’ for them to view it.

About the Vimeo integration with Axero

This article discusses how to share and embed Vimeo videos within various features of Axero to enhance communication and collaboration in organizations. Axero is a software company that specializes in creating a product to streamline workflows, enhance team productivity, and foster effective communication within organizations.

  • How to share a video on a wall post
  • How to add a video on Axero
  • How to embed videos within other content types
  • How to share a video in a comment

How to share a video on a wall post

  1. Find your video link on Vimeo by selecting the Share button on the player or from the video’s edit page.
  2. Copy the video URL from Vimeo and then navigate to your Axero homepage.
  3. Paste the URL into a wall post on Axero and click the Post button.

How to add a video on Axero

You can share a video from a specific space on Axero by using either the video URL or embed code.

  1. Find your video link and embed code on Vimeo under the Share button.
  2. Create a video on Axero, which can be done from within a Space by clicking on Add a videoor by clicking the + icon in the top right-hand side of the screen and selecting Video.
  3. Paste the Vimeo link in Video URLbox. Alternatively, you can paste the Vimeo embed code under the Embed codetab.
  4. Fill in the rest of the required information (Title, Summary, Category, etc.)
  5. Click Saveand Publish.

How to embed videos within other content types

You can incorporate a video into other Axero content types like Articles or Blogs using either the Vimeo video URL or an embed code.

  1. Find your video link and embed code on Vimeo under the Share button.
  2. Create a new piece of content, e.g. by clicking Add Article.
  3. Fill in the rest of the required information (Title, Summary, Category, upload a featured image, etc.).
  4. In the Rich Text Editor, click Insert Media.
  5. Copy the embed code and paste it in the provided placeholder box.
  6. Click Save and Publish.

On a Page Builder page

You can share a video on a page builder page with URL link and embed code.

  1. Find your video link and embed code on Vimeo under the Share button.
  2. Click on the pencil icon in the upper right corner > Edit Page.
  3. Click and drag Raw HTML widget onto the Page Builder page.
  4. Click on the gear icon > Edit properties.
  5. In the source code editor that opens, paste a video embed code.
  6. ClickSave Widgetand Publish Changes.

How to share a video in a comment

Share a video in a comment with a URL link and embed code.

  1. Find your video link and embed code on Vimeo under the Share button.
  2. Go to the comments section and select Insert Media button.
  3. Copy a video embed codeand paste it in the provided placeholder box.
  4. Save and Add Comment.

To read more, visit Axero’s help center: Vimeo Integration.

About Vimeo’s integration with Rev

Rev provides human-generated captions and global subtitles in 15+ languages, which can be ordered directly from your videos on Vimeo. Rev’s services can help you work faster, engage broader audiences, and make your video content more accessible to your viewers. Once ordered, you can expect to see Rev’s captions available on your video’s transcript panel within 24-48 hours.

If you have a paid plan on Vimeo, you can also activate automatic closed captions provided by Rev for videos in English.

Why has Vimeo partnered with Rev?

We’ve partnered with Rev to provide users with more ways to add captions to their Vimeo videos.

How does the Rev integration impact my videos?

You can turn on auto closed captions to access Rev’s AI captions, which are available in English only. You can also order Rev’s human-generated captions and subtitles in 15+ languages for videos in English. Read more at How to order captions and subtitles with Rev.

Link your Vimeo account with Rev

If you already have existing accounts at both Rev and Vimeo, you can link your accounts to help you work faster. You will see a prompt to link your accounts once you have placed an order with Rev, see steps at How to order captions and subtitles with Rev or Rev’s guide here.

Once your accounts are linked, your completed captions or subtitles from Rev will be uploaded directly onto your video. That means you won’t have to download caption or subtitle files from Rev’s website and manually upload them onto your video on Vimeo.

Auto Pull Vimeo videos in Rev

Linking your Rev and Vimeo accounts will give you the option to enable Rev’s Auto Pull feature. With Auto Pull enabled, any video you upload to your Vimeo account will automatically be submitted to Rev for human-generated captions. Once your caption file is completed, it will then automatically upload to your video’s [CC] settings.
